Surat: Diamond workers get a shorter Diwali break as four years of slump finally end.

સુરત: હીરા ઉદ્યોગમાં ચાર વર્ષની મંદી પછી તેજી, દિવાળી વેકેશન ટૂંકું રહેશે.

Diamond Worker Union VP Bhavesh Shah says fresh orders have factories working through the usual month off -- vacation from 5 Nov now 15-20 days, not 30. Union wants the slump's 20% wage cuts restored.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
